attempts.text:
NIPURN JAIN
PROCUREMENT ANALYST
jainnipurn99@gmail.com
Sector - 28 Gurugram
91+8881135628
SUMMARY
Master in Business Administration (MBA) with 5+ Years of experience, currently
Working in Project of Bank of America as a procurement and sourcing Analyst.
Working as a buyer for IT related Products, PR to PO, Approving Invoices,
Negotiating with suppliers, Managing direct and indirect sourcing , Managing
contracting and managing vendor database .
EXPERIENCE
2022 To Present
MICROLAND (PROJECT - BANK OF AMERICA)
Procurement analyst
	Working as Buyer in IT Hardware And IT services related Used in our Organization

	We are working on all there mode of transaction like INR Duty paid, INR Duty free ( Bond To Bond/ GST free)

	And USD on the basis of L1.

	Developing Sourcing Strategy based on Requirement and executing Negotiation.

	Ensure Procurement Policy guideline are meet with formal approvals..

	Managing around  All suppliers including international suppliers and local suppliers.

	Liaising with management for budget approval  Capex or Opex.

	Strategic Planning , Budgeting Forecasts for inventor management. And Adhere to TAT for order closure.

	Participating in contract negotiation with incumbent suppliers and potential new suppliers.

	Working on tools SAP And Ariba.

	Tracking PO material delivery timeline And Maintain MSME vendor payment timeline.

	Ensuring “Procure to Pay process “is followed for all transactions.


2018 TO 2022
BASANT PRODUCT INDIA
Procurement Analyst
	Participating in Contract negotiation with incumbent Supplier and potential


New supplier. Monitoring contracts that are reaching expiration and work
With Business Partners for renewal or termination.
	Communicating with all Stakeholders on regular basis to identify any risk and timely mitigating the risk.

	Involved in internal audit and compliance activities conducted by internal department and third party.

	Supporting multiple Business function doing spend analysis , PR To PO


Using e-Portal ,approving Invoices, Contract management.
	Managing vendor database and developing and adding New vendor in Database on regular basis.




2015 TO 2017
HINDUSTAN ISTITUTE OF MANAGMENT
AND COMPUTER STUDIES
Master in Business Adminstration (MBA)
2013 To 2015
DR. BHIM RAO AMBEDKAR UNIVERSITY
BACHELOR OF COMMERCE
SKILLS
	Strategic Sourcing

	Vendor Management

	Negotiation


	Contract Management

	RFX Bidding

	Procurement
